[[Kilgor Rageheart]] is a [[collector]], an NPC that trades you items and weapons in exchange for [[trophy|trophies]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Vloxen Excavations}} (level 1)

==Dialogue==
:''"Heroes, eh? So, that means you travel around killin' critters and takin' their stuff, huh? Good. Just what I need. You see, I have some critters that need killin' and stuff that needs takin'. [[Skelk]]. That's what I'm talkin' about. I hate them beasties. They just need killin', I tell you. Bring me 5 [[Skelk Fang]]s and I'll pay you for your troubles."''
